## User Concern
独立・起業を考えてるんだけど、準備すべきことが多すぎて整理できてない。資金、スキル、人脈、事業計画、いろいろあるけど何から手をつければいいか。時系列で整理して、いつまでに何をすべきか明確にしたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. brainstorm_cards - 起業に関するあらゆる要素（資金・スキル・人脈・事業案など）を自由に洗い出すため
2. question_card_chain - 重要な疑問（なぜ起業するか、ターゲットは誰か、必要資金はいくらか等）を深掘りし、思考の流れを可視化するため
Purpose: 起業に必要な要素と疑問を幅広く洗い出し、考えを広げる
Target: 資金・スキル・人脈・事業計画など、ユーザーが混乱している要素の全体像の把握
Ports:
brainstorm_cards (complexity: 0.2):

  OUT: cards (object[])
  OUT: cardCount (number)
  GENERATE: config.sampleCards

question_card_chain (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: questions (string[])
  OUT: answers (object[])
  OUT: completedCount (number)

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - 洗い出したカード（項目）をカテゴリ（資金/スキル/人脈/計画/リスク等）に分類するため
2. dependency_mapping - カテゴリ化した要素の依存関係を可視化し、どれが先に着手すべきか（ブロッキング関係）を明らかにするため
3. timeline_slider - 重要なタスクや依存関係を時間軸に配置し、いつまでに何をするかの大枠を作るため
Purpose: 洗い出した要素を分類し、依存関係と時間軸上の位置を整理する
Target: 何が優先で、どの要素が他をブロックしているか、いつまでに何を配置すべきかの骨子
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

dependency_mapping (complexity: 0.7):
  IN: nodes (object[])
  OUT: edges (object[])
  OUT: criticalPath (string[])
  OUT: hasLoop (boolean)

timeline_slider (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: events (object[])
  OUT: timeline (object[])
  OUT: currentPosition (number)

### Converge Section
1. matrix_placement - 優先度と実行可能性など2軸でタスクを配置し、どれを先に着手するかを視覚的に決めるため
2. priority_slider_grid - 複数の具体的タスクに対して優先度スコアを付け、実行順を確定するため
Purpose: 重要事項を絞り込み、実行可能な優先順位とアクションプランを決定する
Target: まず取り組むべき上位タスク（例：最低資金確保、主要スキル習得、最初の顧客検証等）
Ports:
matrix_placement (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: items (object[])
  IN: axisLabels (object)
  OUT: placements (object[])
  OUT: quadrantCounts (object)

priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

generatedData.rationale: 診断で'thought'が課題のため、発散で多面的に情報を引き出す高汎用Widgets（brainstorm_cards, question_card_chain）と感情の可視化を併用し、整理フェーズでは分類と比較（card_sorting, matrix_placement, swot_analysis）で判断材料を構造化。収束では優先度付けと重み付け（priority_slider_grid, tradeoff_balance）で定量的に比較し、最後にstructured_summaryで結論とアクションをまとめる。各ステージのcomplexity合計はステージごとに0.8以下を意識して選定している（diverge: ~0.7、organize: ~0.6、converge: ~0.8、summary: ~0.2）。
generatedData.flowDescription: 1) Diverge：カードと質問で要素を網羅的に洗い出し、感情を可視化して冷静さを確保。2) Organize：カードをカテゴリ化し、重要度と実現可能性のマトリクスで配置、SWOTで戦略的観点を補う。3) Converge：優先度を数値化してランキング化し、天秤で移住と現状維持を重み付け比較して推奨を生成。4) Summary：推奨と主要ポイント、残存リスク、具体的な次アクションを構造化して提示。

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "タスクを整理して時系列に並べて優先度も決めたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
[ ] brainstorm_cards: config.sampleCards (samples, 2-3 items)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to タスクを整理して時系列に並べて優先度も決めたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
タスクを整理して時系列に並べて優先度も決めたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. brainstorm_cards - タスクや関連アイデアを自由に書き出して量を増やす（まず全てのタスク候補を抽出）
2. question_card_chain - 出したタスクに対して「何が必要か」「期限はいつか」「依存はあるか」等の質問で掘り下げる
Purpose: 思考を広げ、すべてのタスク候補とそれに関する基本情報を引き出すフェーズ
Target: タスク候補の収集と各タスクの背景・条件の掘り下げ
Ports:
brainstorm_cards (complexity: 0.2):

  OUT: cards (object[])
  OUT: cardCount (number)
  GENERATE: config.sampleCards

question_card_chain (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: questions (string[])
  OUT: answers (object[])
  OUT: completedCount (number)

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - 収集したカードをカテゴリ（プロジェクト別・緊急度・種類など）で整理する
2. dependency_mapping - タスク間の依存関係を可視化し、順序やブロッキングを特定する（時系列と順序付けの基礎）
3. timeline_slider - 依存・カテゴリ情報を基に各タスクを時間軸上に配置して大まかなスケジュールを作る
Purpose: 収集したタスクを分類し、依存関係と大まかな時系列を作るフェーズ
Target: タスクの順序付け・依存の整理・時間軸配置
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

dependency_mapping (complexity: 0.7):
  IN: nodes (object[])
  OUT: edges (object[])
  OUT: criticalPath (string[])
  OUT: hasLoop (boolean)

timeline_slider (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: events (object[])
  OUT: timeline (object[])
  OUT: currentPosition (number)

### Converge Section
1. matrix_placement - 優先度判断の補助として2軸（重要度×緊急度など）で配置して視覚的に比較する
2. priority_slider_grid - 最終的にタスクごとに数値で優先度を付け、実行順（ランク）を確定する
Purpose: 視覚的比較と数値的評価で優先順位と実行順を決定するフェーズ
Target: タスクの最終優先度付けと実行順の決定
Ports:
matrix_placement (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: items (object[])
  IN: axisLabels (object)
  OUT: placements (object[])
  OUT: quadrantCounts (object)

priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "チーム内の問題を解決したい。課題を出して、関係性を整理して、優先度つけて対策を立てたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
[ ] brainstorm_cards: config.sampleCards (samples, 2-3 items)
[ ] swot_analysis: config.sampleItems (samples, 4-4 items)
[ ] tradeoff_balance: config.items (samples, 2-4 items)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to チーム内の問題を解決したい。課題を出して、関係性を整理して、優先度つけて対策を立てたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:

チーム内の問題を解決したい。課題を出して、関係性を整理して、優先度つけて対策を立てたい

### Organize Section

### Converge Section
1. matrix_placement - 影響度×実行可能性などの2軸で課題・対策候補を配置して優先度を視覚化する
2. priority_slider_grid - 矩形配置で見えた候補に対して個別に優先度スコアを割り当て、最終ランキング化する
3. tradeoff_balance - 例えばリソースを優先するかスピードを優先するか等、主要な意思決定に対してトレードオフ評価を行う
Purpose: 対応策を絞り込み、実行順と重点を決める
Target: 実行すべき対策の優先順位付けと主要な意思決定

matrix_placement (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: items (object[])
  IN: axisLabels (object)
  OUT: placements (object[])
  OUT: quadrantCounts (object)

priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

tradeoff_balance (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: balance (number)
  OUT: direction (string)
  OUT: recommendation (string)
  GENERATE: config.items

summary.target: 最終計画の確認と次のアクションの明文化
summary.purpose: 作成した学習計画を短く整理し、実行に移すための次の具体的ステップを提示する（まとめ）。

widgets.purpose: 全体の計画・優先度・依存関係・タイムラインを構造化して要約し、次のアクションを明確にする。

summary.description: 構造化サマリーで主要ポイント（学習順序、重要項目、期限、次の数アクション）を抽出して提示。ユーザーがすぐ実行できる形にまとめる。

converge.target: 優先順位の確定、学習時間配分、現実的な計画調整
converge.purpose: 優先度と現実的な配分を確定し、具体的な行動（何をいつどれくらいやるか）に収束させる（収束）。

widgets.purpose: 各学習項目に優先度（取り組む順と比重）を割り当て、日々の学習配分を決める。
学習時間配分と仕事/生活とのトレードオフを視覚化し、現実的な計画に調整する（無理のないバランス判定）。

converge.description: 優先度スライダーで項目ごとの重み付けを行い、トレードオフ天秤で生活制約とのバランスを検討して最終的なスケジュールを微調整する。

organize.target: 依存関係の可視化、カテゴリ化、試験日までのマイルストーン設定
organize.purpose: 洗い出した要素を依存順・カテゴリ・時間軸で構造化し、学習の順序と大枠スケジュールを確定する（整理）。

widgets.purpose: カード化された学習項目の依存関係（何が先に必要か）を明確にし、クリティカルパスや循環を検出する。
学習項目をカテゴリ（基礎・応用・過去問対策・暗記項目など）で分類し、段階化して見やすくする。
依存関係とカテゴリを踏まえて、試験日から逆算した時系列の大まかな学習スケジュールを作る（マイルストーン配置）。

organize.description: 依存関係マップで優先順とクリティカルパスを抽出、カードソートでカテゴリ化、タイムラインスライダーで時間軸に落とし込む。これにより実行可能な順序と期限が得られる。

generatedData.rationale: ユーザーは「範囲を洗い出し、依存関係を整理し、時系列で計画を立てたい」という思考上のボトルネックを抱えているため、発散ではマインドマップ／ブレインストーミング／質問チェーンで範囲と前提を広げ掘り下げ、整理では依存関係マップとカードソートで順序とカテゴリを確定しタイムラインへ落とし込む。収束では優先度付けとトレードオフ検討で現実的な配分を決め、まとめでは構造化サマリーで次アクションを明確化する。各ステージの選定はmetadata.bottleneckとの親和性、stage適合性を優先し、各ステージの合計complexityが0.8以下となるよう機能バランスを考慮した。

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 資格範囲の洗い出しとトピックの放射的展開。中心に資格名を置き、出題分野・サブトピックを展開することで範囲を可視化する。
2. brainstorm_cards - マインドマップで出た個々の学習項目やタスクをカード化して自由に追加。抜けや細かな要素を拾い上げるため。
3. question_card_chain - 各トピックに対する確認質問（何を理解すべきか、先に学ぶべき基礎は何か）を展開し、思考の深掘りを行う。
Purpose: 資格試験の範囲を広く洗い出し、各項目の背景と疑問点を明らかにする（発散）。
Target: 試験範囲・学習項目・前提知識・細分タスクの収集と深掘り

mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

brainstorm_cards (complexity: 0.2):

  OUT: cards (object[])
  OUT: cardCount (number)
  GENERATE: config.sampleCards

question_card_chain (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: questions (string[])
  OUT: answers (object[])
  OUT: completedCount (number)

### Organize Section
1. dependency_mapping - カード化された学習項目の依存関係（何が先に必要か）を明確にし、クリティカルパスや循環を検出する。
2. card_sorting - 学習項目をカテゴリ（基礎・応用・過去問対策・暗記項目など）で分類し、段階化して見やすくする。
3. timeline_slider - 依存関係とカテゴリを踏まえて、試験日から逆算した時系列の大まかな学習スケジュールを作る（マイルストーン配置）。
Purpose: 洗い出した要素を依存順・カテゴリ・時間軸で構造化し、学習の順序と大枠スケジュールを確定する（整理）。
Target: 依存関係の可視化、カテゴリ化、試験日までのマイルストーン設定
Ports:
dependency_mapping (complexity: 0.7):
  IN: nodes (object[])
  OUT: edges (object[])
  OUT: criticalPath (string[])
  OUT: hasLoop (boolean)

card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

timeline_slider (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: events (object[])
  OUT: timeline (object[])
  OUT: currentPosition (number)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 各学習項目に優先度（取り組む順と比重）を割り当て、日々の学習配分を決める。
2. tradeoff_balance - 学習時間配分と仕事/生活とのトレードオフを視覚化し、現実的な計画に調整する（無理のないバランス判定）。
Purpose: 優先度と現実的な配分を確定し、具体的な行動（何をいつどれくらいやるか）に収束させる（収束）。
Target: 優先順位の確定、学習時間配分、現実的な計画調整
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

tradeoff_balance (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: balance (number)
  OUT: direction (string)
  OUT: recommendation (string)
  GENERATE: config.items

generatedData.rationale: ユーザーのボトルネックが「planning」であるため、発散→整理→収束→まとめの流れで選択肢を可視化し、依存関係と時間軸を明確にするWidgetを中心に選定しました。divergeでは幅広く情報を出すための高汎用なブレインストームと質問チェーン、感情の可視化を組み合わせ、organizeでは分類・依存関係検出・タイムラインで現実的な計画を作成。convergeではマトリクスとトレードオフで意思決定を支援し、優先度スライダーで行動順を確定。summaryで構造化された実行プランを出力します。各ステージの合計complexityは概ね制約内に収め、timingは発散から遅い段階へと整合しています。
generatedData.flowDescription: 1) Diverge: ブレインストームカードで全選択肢・懸念を列挙し、質問カードで各項目を深掘り、感情パレットで心理的重みを把握。2) Organize: 列挙したカードをカテゴリ化し、依存関係マップで順序やブロッカーを可視化、タイムラインに配置して実行時期を想定。3) Converge: マトリクスで実現可能性と影響を比較、トレードオフ天秤で具体的比較を行い、優先度スライダーで最終的な優先順位と行動順を決定。4) Summary: 構造化サマリーで結論と期限付きアクションをまとめ、次のステップを明確にする。

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "副業を始めたいが、何から手をつければいいか分からない。アイデアはいくつかあるが整理できていない"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 副業を始めたいが、何から手をつければいいか分からない。アイデアはいくつかあるが整理できていない", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

副業を始めたいが、何から手をつければいいか分からない。アイデアはいくつかあるが整理できていない

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "転職活動中。候補企業をリストアップしたが、分類して整理したい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 転職活動中。候補企業をリストアップしたが、分類して整理したい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
転職活動中。候補企業をリストアップしたが、分類して整理したい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 候補企業を中心トピックとして関連する特徴や条件を広く発想し、分類の下地を作るため。
Purpose: 候補企業に関する情報や分類の切り口を幅広く洗い出す。
Target: 候補企業の特性や比較軸の発見
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - 発散フェーズで洗い出した企業情報カードをカテゴリ別に整理する。
Purpose: 企業情報を手掛かりに分類・グルーピングし、視覚的にまとまりを作る。
Target: 企業特性のカテゴリ構造
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 分類した候補企業の優先順位を設定し、どこへ応募するか意思決定を促す。
Purpose: 応募すべき企業の優先付けによって行動計画に繋げる。
Target: 応募優先度の高い企業リスト
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)
{
  "diverge": [
    {
      "id": "mind_map",
      "name": "マインドマップ",
      "description": "中心トピックから放射状にアイデアを展開。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "centralTopic",
          "dataType": "string",
          "description": "中心トピック",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "nodes",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "マインドマップのノード"
        },
        {
          "id": "connections",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ノード間の接続"
        },
        {
          "id": "depth",
          "dataType": "number",
          "description": "最大の深さ"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "card_sorting",
      "name": "カードソート",
      "description": "カードをカテゴリにドラッグ&ドロップで分類。",
      "complexity": 0.4,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "cards",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ソートするカードリスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "categories",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "カテゴリごとのカード配置"
        },
        {
          "id": "uncategorized",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "未分類のカード"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "converge": [
    {
      "id": "priority_slider_grid",
      "name": "優先度スライダー",
      "description": "複数の項目に対してスライダーで優先度を設定。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度を設定する項目リスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "priorities",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度情報 {id: string, label: string, priority: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "ranking",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "優先度順のID配列"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

## ORS Data Structure

        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "dependencyGraph": {
    "dependencies": [],
    "metadata": {
      "version": "5.0",
      "generatedAt": 1765541368873
    }
  },
  "metadata": {

    "llmModel": "fallback",
    "sessionId": "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-102",
    "concernText": "転職活動中。候補企業をリストアップしたが、分類して整理したい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  }
}

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-102"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

widgets.purpose: 整理されたストレス要因カテゴリに優先度を付け、対応順序を決める

converge.description: 各カテゴリや要因項目にスライダーを使って優先度スコアを設定し、順位付けする

organize.description: カード形式の要素をドラッグ＆ドロップで分類し、関連性のあるグループを形成する

generatedData.rationale: ユーザーのボトルネック種別がthoughtであり、まず質問で深掘りし思考を可視化できるquestion_card_chainを選択。organizeでは分類に強いcard_sortingを採用し、convergeには優先度付けに適したpriority_slider_grid、最後はsummaryステージに必須のstructured_summaryを用いて全体をまとめる。各ステージのcomplexity合計は0.8未満に抑え、発散から収束まで時系列的にタイミング値が増えるように選定。
generatedData.flowDescription: まず質問でストレス要因と感情を広く抽出し(発散)、次にカード分類で構造化(整理)、その後優先度付けで収束し、最後に構造化サマリーで全体を俯瞰して行動方針を確認する4ステップの思考整理フロー。

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "人生の選択肢を整理中。マインドマップで書き出した考えを2軸で評価したい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 人生の選択肢を整理中。マインドマップで書き出した考えを2軸で評価したい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- matrix_placement_0.placements → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- matrix_placement_0.quadrantCounts → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
人生の選択肢を整理中。マインドマップで書き出した考えを2軸で評価したい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 既にあるマインドマップを活用しつつ、人生の選択肢や関連する考えを網羅的に展開するため
Purpose: 考えや情報を広く発散させ、深く関連性を探る
Target: ユーザーの人生の選択肢に関する思考の全体像
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. matrix_placement - マインドマップで洗い出した選択肢を2軸評価で配置し、比較のための構造化を行うため
Purpose: 発散した情報を論理的に整理し、比較可能な形に整える
Target: 選択肢間の位置関係と相対的価値
Ports:
matrix_placement (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: items (object[])
  IN: axisLabels (object)
  OUT: placements (object[])
  OUT: quadrantCounts (object)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - マトリクス評価の結果から、実行優先度を具体的に数値化して決定につなげるため
Purpose: 選択肢を絞り込み、行動に移す優先順位を明確化する
Target: 実行に移す候補の優先度リスト
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "プロジェクトのタスクを洗い出した。これを時系列に並べて計画を立てたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to プロジェクトのタスクを洗い出した。これを時系列に並べて計画を立てたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.nodes → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- dependency_mapping_0.edges → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.criticalPath → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.hasLoop → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_1.timeline → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_1.currentPosition → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
プロジェクトのタスクを洗い出した。これを時系列に並べて計画を立てたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - タスク間の関連性や構造を広く探り、時系列計画の基礎となる情報を発散的に洗い出すため
Purpose: 発散フェーズでタスク間の関係やサブタスク、必要な追加要素を可視化しながら探る
Target: 計画対象となるすべてのタスクや関連事項
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. dependency_mapping - タスク間の依存関係や順序を整理し、時系列化の準備を整えるため
2. timeline_slider - 依存関係を踏まえてイベントやタスクを時間軸に沿って配置するため
Purpose: 整理フェーズでタスクを依存関係と時間軸の両面から整理する
Target: 発散フェーズで抽出されたタスク群
Ports:
dependency_mapping (complexity: 0.7):
  IN: nodes (object[])
  OUT: edges (object[])
  OUT: criticalPath (string[])
  OUT: hasLoop (boolean)

timeline_slider (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: events (object[])
  OUT: timeline (object[])
  OUT: currentPosition (number)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 各タスクの重要度や緊急度を評価し、計画の実行順や重点を決定するため
Purpose: 収束フェーズで優先順位を設定し、実行計画を固める
Target: 整理されたタスクとその時間配置
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)
{
  "diverge": [
    {
      "id": "mind_map",
      "name": "マインドマップ",
      "description": "中心トピックから放射状にアイデアを展開。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "centralTopic",
          "dataType": "string",
          "description": "中心トピック",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "nodes",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "マインドマップのノード"
        },
        {
          "id": "connections",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ノード間の接続"
        },
        {
          "id": "depth",
          "dataType": "number",
          "description": "最大の深さ"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "dependency_mapping",
      "name": "依存関係マップ",
      "description": "タスクや要素間の依存関係をノードとエッジで可視化。クリティカルパスや循環依存を自動検出。",
      "complexity": 0.7,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "nodes",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ノードリスト。各ノードは {id: string, label: string, x?: number, y?: number} の形式。",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "edges",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "接続エッジリスト。各エッジは {sourceId: string, targetId: string, type: string} の形式。"
        },
        {
          "id": "criticalPath",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "クリティカルパス（最長依存チェーン）のノードID配列"
        },
        {
          "id": "hasLoop",
          "dataType": "boolean",
          "description": "循環依存が存在するかどうか"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "timeline_slider",
      "name": "タイムラインスライダー",
      "description": "時間軸に沿ってイベントや計画を配置。",
      "complexity": 0.4,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "events",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "イベントリスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "timeline",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "時系列に並んだイベント"
        },
        {
          "id": "currentPosition",
          "dataType": "number",
          "description": "現在のスライダー位置"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "converge": [
    {
      "id": "priority_slider_grid",
      "name": "優先度スライダー",
      "description": "複数の項目に対してスライダーで優先度を設定。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度を設定する項目リスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "priorities",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度情報 {id: string, label: string, priority: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "ranking",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "優先度順のID配列"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

## ORS Data Structure
{
  "version": "5.0",
  "planMetadata": {
    "concernText": "プロジェクトのタスクを洗い出した。これを時系列に並べて計画を立てたい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  },
  "entities": [
    {
      "id": "concern",
      "type": "concern",
      "attributes": [
        {
          "name": "text",
          "structuralType": "SVAL",
          "valueType": "string",
          "description": "ユーザーの元の悩みテキスト"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "dependencyGraph": {
    "dependencies": [],
    "metadata": {
      "version": "5.0",
      "generatedAt": 1765541464767
    }
  },
  "metadata": {
    "generatedAt": 1765541464767,
    "llmModel": "fallback",
    "sessionId": "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-106",
    "concernText": "プロジェクトのタスクを洗い出した。これを時系列に並べて計画を立てたい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  }
}

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-106"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "今抱えてるタスクが多すぎて頭の中がごちゃごちゃ。一回整理したい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 今抱えてるタスクが多すぎて頭の中がごちゃごちゃ。一回整理したい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
今抱えてるタスクが多すぎて頭の中がごちゃごちゃ。一回整理したい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 頭の中にある多すぎるタスクを放射状に展開し、関連性も含めて網羅的に可視化することで思考の発散を促す。
Purpose: タスクや関連事項を可能な限り多く洗い出し、外部化する。
Target: ユーザーが抱えている多くのタスクや考えを視覚化する
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - 発散段階で生成したタスクや要素をカテゴリごとに整理し、構造化する。
Purpose: 洗い出した情報を分類し、関連項目をまとめる。
Target: タスク群のカテゴリ化とグルーピング
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 分類されたタスクの中から優先度を設定し、どこから取り組むべきか明確化する。
Purpose: 重要度や緊急度に基づいてタスクを順位付けする。
Target: 最優先で対処すべきタスクの特定
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)
{
  "diverge": [
    {
      "id": "mind_map",
      "name": "マインドマップ",
      "description": "中心トピックから放射状にアイデアを展開。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "centralTopic",
          "dataType": "string",
          "description": "中心トピック",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "nodes",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "マインドマップのノード"
        },
        {
          "id": "connections",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ノード間の接続"
        },
        {
          "id": "depth",
          "dataType": "number",
          "description": "最大の深さ"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "card_sorting",
      "name": "カードソート",
      "description": "カードをカテゴリにドラッグ&ドロップで分類。",
      "complexity": 0.4,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "cards",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ソートするカードリスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "categories",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "カテゴリごとのカード配置"
        },
        {
          "id": "uncategorized",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "未分類のカード"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "converge": [
    {
      "id": "priority_slider_grid",
      "name": "優先度スライダー",
      "description": "複数の項目に対してスライダーで優先度を設定。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度を設定する項目リスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "priorities",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度情報 {id: string, label: string, priority: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "ranking",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "優先度順のID配列"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

## ORS Data Structure
{
  "version": "5.0",
  "planMetadata": {
    "concernText": "今抱えてるタスクが多すぎて頭の中がごちゃごちゃ。一回整理したい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  },
  "entities": [
    {
      "id": "concern",
      "type": "concern",
      "attributes": [
        {
          "name": "text",
          "structuralType": "SVAL",
          "valueType": "string",
          "description": "ユーザーの元の悩みテキスト"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "dependencyGraph": {
    "dependencies": [],
    "metadata": {
      "version": "5.0",
      "generatedAt": 1765541590359
    }
  },
  "metadata": {
    "generatedAt": 1765541590359,
    "llmModel": "fallback",
    "sessionId": "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-111",
    "concernText": "今抱えてるタスクが多すぎて頭の中がごちゃごちゃ。一回整理したい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  }
}

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-111"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "節約したいんだけど何を削ればいいかわからない。固定費見直すべきか、日々の出費減らすべきか"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 節約したいんだけど何を削ればいいかわからない。固定費見直すべきか、日々の出費減らすべきか", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- matrix_placement_0.placements → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- matrix_placement_0.quadrantCounts → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
節約したいんだけど何を削ればいいかわからない。固定費見直すべきか、日々の出費減らすべきか

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 固定費削減と日々の出費削減のどちらに注力すべきかを多角的に洗い出すために、関連する支出項目やアイデアを放射状に展開する。
Purpose: 支出削減案やその影響を幅広く洗い出す
Target: 固定費と変動費の削減可能性に関するアイデア
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. matrix_placement - 洗い出した支出項目を効果（節約額）と実行難易度の2軸で可視化し、整理する。
Purpose: アイデアを効果と実行難易度で分類する
Target: 節約アイデアの実行優先度を前提として構造化
Ports:
matrix_placement (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: items (object[])
  IN: axisLabels (object)
  OUT: placements (object[])

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 整理した支出削減案に優先度をつけ、実際に取り組むべき順位を決める。
Purpose: 実施すべき節約策の優先順位を決定する

priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):

  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "資格試験の勉強範囲が広すぎる。まず全体像を把握してから、分野ごとに整理したい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 資格試験の勉強範囲が広すぎる。まず全体像を把握してから、分野ごとに整理したい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.nodes → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_1.timeline → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_1.currentPosition → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
資格試験の勉強範囲が広すぎる。まず全体像を把握してから、分野ごとに整理したい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 資格試験の膨大な範囲を中心トピックから放射状に広げ、全体像を可視化するため
Purpose: 広すぎる試験範囲をまず全体構造として洗い出す
Target: 全範囲の主要テーマや関連分野
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - 広げたトピックを分野別に分類し、カテゴリ構造を作るため
2. timeline_slider - 各分野の学習順序や計画を時系列で配置して、学習スケジュールを明確にするため
Purpose: 分野ごとに体系化し、時間軸上に配置して学習計画を作成する
Target: テーマ分類と学習順序
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

timeline_slider (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: events (object[])
  OUT: timeline (object[])
  OUT: currentPosition (number)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 分野ごとの優先度を設定し、重要な部分から着手するため
Purpose: 学習計画を基に優先順位を決めて集中すべき分野を特定する
Target: 優先度設定と学習順序の最適化

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "今後の人生設計を考えたい。仕事、家庭、趣味、健康、いろんな要素があるけど全部大事で、何を優先すべきかわからない。まずは自分にとって大切なことを全部書き出して、整理してから優先順位をつけたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 今後の人生設計を考えたい。仕事、家庭、趣味、健康、いろんな要素があるけど全部大事で、何を優先すべきかわからない。まずは自分にとって大切なことを全部書き出して、整理してから優先順位をつけたい", "isGenerated": true },

}

- mind_map_0.connections → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)

- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

}

  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",

    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "読みたい本がたまりすぎた。どれから読むか優先度決めて、計画的に消化したい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 読みたい本がたまりすぎた。どれから読むか優先度決めて、計画的に消化したい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- matrix_placement_0.placements → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- matrix_placement_0.quadrantCounts → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
読みたい本がたまりすぎた。どれから読むか優先度決めて、計画的に消化したい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 読みたい本のテーマやジャンルを中心トピックから広げ、全体像を俯瞰することで思考を発散させる
Purpose: 読書対象の情報や関連性を広く洗い出す
Target: 全ての読みたい本のジャンル・テーマ・関連性
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. matrix_placement - 読みたい本を重要度と緊急度の二軸で可視化し、優先度付けの基礎を作る
Purpose: 発散した情報を構造的に整理する
Target: 本のリストを優先度決定の軸に沿って配置
Ports:
matrix_placement (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: items (object[])
  IN: axisLabels (object)
  OUT: placements (object[])
  OUT: quadrantCounts (object)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 整理された本の候補に対してスライダーで優先度を設定し、読む順番を決定する
Purpose: 読む本の順番を決める
Target: 候補本の優先順位
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)
{
  "diverge": [
    {
      "id": "mind_map",
      "name": "マインドマップ",
      "description": "中心トピックから放射状にアイデアを展開。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "centralTopic",
          "dataType": "string",
          "description": "中心トピック",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "nodes",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "マインドマップのノード"
        },
        {
          "id": "connections",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ノード間の接続"
        },
        {
          "id": "depth",
          "dataType": "number",
          "description": "最大の深さ"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "matrix_placement",
      "name": "マトリクス配置",
      "description": "2軸のマトリクス上にアイテムを配置し、位置関係を可視化。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "配置するアイテムリスト",
          "required": false
        },
        {
          "id": "axisLabels",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "軸のラベル {xAxis: {low: string, high: string}, yAxis: {low: string, high: string}}",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "placements",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "アイテムの配置情報 {id: string, x: number, y: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "quadrantCounts",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "各象限のアイテム数"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "converge": [
    {
      "id": "priority_slider_grid",
      "name": "優先度スライダー",
      "description": "複数の項目に対してスライダーで優先度を設定。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度を設定する項目リスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "priorities",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度情報 {id: string, label: string, priority: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "ranking",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "優先度順のID配列"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

## ORS Data Structure
{
  "version": "5.0",
  "planMetadata": {
    "concernText": "読みたい本がたまりすぎた。どれから読むか優先度決めて、計画的に消化したい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  },
  "entities": [
    {
      "id": "concern",
      "type": "concern",
      "attributes": [
        {
          "name": "text",
          "structuralType": "SVAL",
          "valueType": "string",
          "description": "ユーザーの元の悩みテキスト"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "dependencyGraph": {
    "dependencies": [],
    "metadata": {
      "version": "5.0",
      "generatedAt": 1765542081391
    }
  },
  "metadata": {
    "generatedAt": 1765542081391,
    "llmModel": "fallback",
    "sessionId": "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-131",
    "concernText": "読みたい本がたまりすぎた。どれから読むか優先度決めて、計画的に消化したい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  }
}

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-131"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "買いたいものがいっぱいあるけど予算に限りがある。優先度つけて計画的に買いたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 買いたいものがいっぱいあるけど予算に限りがある。優先度つけて計画的に買いたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- matrix_placement_0.placements → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- matrix_placement_0.quadrantCounts → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
買いたいものがいっぱいあるけど予算に限りがある。優先度つけて計画的に買いたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 予算内で購入したいものの全体像や関連性を広げて把握するため
Purpose: 購入希望アイテムの洗い出しと関連付けによる思考の発散
Target: 欲しいものの全体像と関係性を可視化する
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. matrix_placement - 欲しいものを重要度と価格などの二軸で整理し優先度の下地を作るため
Purpose: 発散したアイテムを必要度と価格軸で整理する
Target: アイテムの価格帯と必要度のマッピング
Ports:
matrix_placement (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: items (object[])
  IN: axisLabels (object)
  OUT: placements (object[])
  OUT: quadrantCounts (object)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 整理済みアイテムから実際の購入優先度を数値化して絞り込むため
Purpose: 購入優先度を設定し予算内に収める具体案を絞る
Target: 購入優先度の定量化
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)
{
  "diverge": [
    {
      "id": "mind_map",
      "name": "マインドマップ",
      "description": "中心トピックから放射状にアイデアを展開。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "centralTopic",
          "dataType": "string",
          "description": "中心トピック",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "nodes",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "マインドマップのノード"
        },
        {
          "id": "connections",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ノード間の接続"
        },
        {
          "id": "depth",
          "dataType": "number",
          "description": "最大の深さ"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "matrix_placement",
      "name": "マトリクス配置",
      "description": "2軸のマトリクス上にアイテムを配置し、位置関係を可視化。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "配置するアイテムリスト",
          "required": false
        },
        {
          "id": "axisLabels",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "軸のラベル {xAxis: {low: string, high: string}, yAxis: {low: string, high: string}}",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "placements",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "アイテムの配置情報 {id: string, x: number, y: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "quadrantCounts",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "各象限のアイテム数"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "converge": [
    {
      "id": "priority_slider_grid",
      "name": "優先度スライダー",
      "description": "複数の項目に対してスライダーで優先度を設定。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度を設定する項目リスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "priorities",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度情報 {id: string, label: string, priority: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "ranking",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "優先度順のID配列"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

## ORS Data Structure
{
  "version": "5.0",
  "planMetadata": {
    "concernText": "買いたいものがいっぱいあるけど予算に限りがある。優先度つけて計画的に買いたい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  },
  "entities": [
    {
      "id": "concern",
      "type": "concern",
      "attributes": [
        {
          "name": "text",
          "structuralType": "SVAL",
          "valueType": "string",
          "description": "ユーザーの元の悩みテキスト"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "dependencyGraph": {
    "dependencies": [],
    "metadata": {
      "version": "5.0",
      "generatedAt": 1765542030081
    }
  },
  "metadata": {
    "generatedAt": 1765542030081,
    "llmModel": "fallback",
    "sessionId": "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-129",
    "concernText": "買いたいものがいっぱいあるけど予算に限りがある。優先度つけて計画的に買いたい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  }
}

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-129"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "職場の人間関係で複数の問題が絡み合ってる。上司との関係、同僚との協力、後輩の指導。それぞれの課題を整理してから優先順位つけたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 職場の人間関係で複数の問題が絡み合ってる。上司との関係、同僚との協力、後輩の指導。それぞれの課題を整理してから優先順位つけたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
職場の人間関係で複数の問題が絡み合ってる。上司との関係、同僚との協力、後輩の指導。それぞれの課題を整理してから優先順位つけたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 複数の人間関係の課題を中心トピックから放射状に展開し、関連性を可視化して広く洗い出す
Purpose: 関係する課題や要因をできるだけ多く広げる
Target: 上司との関係、同僚との協力、後輩の指導に関する要素
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - 発散フェーズで出てきた課題や要素をカテゴリ分けし、構造立てして整理する
Purpose: 洗い出した課題を整理し、関連するもの同士を分類する
Target: 発散した課題リスト
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 整理されたカテゴリ内の課題について優先度を設定し、取り組み順を決定する
Purpose: 重要度と緊急度を考慮して課題の優先順位を決める
Target: カテゴリ化された課題群
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)
{
  "diverge": [
    {
      "id": "mind_map",
      "name": "マインドマップ",
      "description": "中心トピックから放射状にアイデアを展開。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "centralTopic",
          "dataType": "string",
          "description": "中心トピック",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "nodes",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "マインドマップのノード"
        },
        {
          "id": "connections",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ノード間の接続"
        },
        {
          "id": "depth",
          "dataType": "number",
          "description": "最大の深さ"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "card_sorting",
      "name": "カードソート",
      "description": "カードをカテゴリにドラッグ&ドロップで分類。",
      "complexity": 0.4,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "cards",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ソートするカードリスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "categories",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "カテゴリごとのカード配置"
        },
        {
          "id": "uncategorized",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "未分類のカード"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "converge": [
    {
      "id": "priority_slider_grid",
      "name": "優先度スライダー",
      "description": "複数の項目に対してスライダーで優先度を設定。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度を設定する項目リスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "priorities",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度情報 {id: string, label: string, priority: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "ranking",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "優先度順のID配列"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

## ORS Data Structure
{
  "version": "5.0",
  "planMetadata": {
    "concernText": "職場の人間関係で複数の問題が絡み合ってる。上司との関係、同僚との協力、後輩の指導。それぞれの課題を整理してから優先順位つけたい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  },
  "entities": [
    {
      "id": "concern",
      "type": "concern",
      "attributes": [
        {
          "name": "text",
          "structuralType": "SVAL",
          "valueType": "string",
          "description": "ユーザーの元の悩みテキスト"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "dependencyGraph": {
    "dependencies": [],
    "metadata": {
      "version": "5.0",
      "generatedAt": 1765542247983
    }
  },
  "metadata": {
    "generatedAt": 1765542247983,
    "llmModel": "fallback",
    "sessionId": "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-137",
    "concernText": "職場の人間関係で複数の問題が絡み合ってる。上司との関係、同僚との協力、後輩の指導。それぞれの課題を整理してから優先順位つけたい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  }
}

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-137"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "プログラミング学習で行き詰まってる。いろんな言語やフレームワークに手を出しすぎて、どれも中途半端。一度整理して集中すべきものを決めたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to プログラミング学習で行き詰まってる。いろんな言語やフレームワークに手を出しすぎて、どれも中途半端。一度整理して集中すべきものを決めたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- matrix_placement_0.placements → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- matrix_placement_0.quadrantCounts → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "タスクを整理して時系列に並べて優先度も決めたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to タスクを整理して時系列に並べて優先度も決めたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.nodes → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- dependency_mapping_0.edges → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.criticalPath → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.hasLoop → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_1.timeline → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_1.currentPosition → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
タスクを整理して時系列に並べて優先度も決めたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - タスクの構造や関連性を発散的に洗い出し、全体像を把握するため
Purpose: 全タスクや関連情報を自由に発想して広げる
Target: タスクの項目出しと関係性の把握
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. dependency_mapping - タスク間の順序や依存関係を明確化する
2. timeline_slider - 依存関係を考慮した時系列配置を行う
Purpose: 発散したタスクを構造化して順序付ける
Target: タスクの依存関係整理と時系列化
Ports:
dependency_mapping (complexity: 0.7):
  IN: nodes (object[])
  OUT: edges (object[])
  OUT: criticalPath (string[])
  OUT: hasLoop (boolean)

timeline_slider (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: events (object[])
  OUT: timeline (object[])
  OUT: currentPosition (number)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 時系列上のタスクに優先度を付与し、着手順を決定する
Purpose: 優先順位を決定して実行順を固める
Target: 優先度設定と着手順序の確定
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])
