# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-141"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "チーム内の問題を解決したい。課題を出して、関係性を整理して、優先度つけて対策を立てたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to チーム内の問題を解決したい。課題を出して、関係性を整理して、優先度つけて対策を立てたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- dependency_mapping_0.edges → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.criticalPath → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.hasLoop → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
チーム内の問題を解決したい。課題を出して、関係性を整理して、優先度つけて対策を立てたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - チーム内の課題を中心トピックから放射状に展開し、関連する要素を幅広く洗い出すため。
Purpose: 課題や関連要素を漏れなく洗い出す
Target: チーム課題のアイデアや要因
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. dependency_mapping - 課題間の依存関係を可視化し、解決の順序や重要な部分を特定するため。
Purpose: 課題を構造化して関係性を把握する
Target: 課題同士のつながりと順序
Ports:
dependency_mapping (complexity: 0.7):
  IN: nodes (object[])
  OUT: edges (object[])
  OUT: criticalPath (string[])
  OUT: hasLoop (boolean)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 整理された課題の優先順位を数値で決定し、解決アクションの着手順を決めるため。
Purpose: 解決施策や課題の優先度を明確化する
Target: 課題解決の優先順位
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)
{
  "diverge": [
    {
      "id": "mind_map",
      "name": "マインドマップ",
      "description": "中心トピックから放射状にアイデアを展開。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "centralTopic",
          "dataType": "string",
          "description": "中心トピック",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "nodes",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "マインドマップのノード"
        },
        {
          "id": "connections",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ノード間の接続"
        },
        {
          "id": "depth",
          "dataType": "number",
          "description": "最大の深さ"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "dependency_mapping",
      "name": "依存関係マップ",
      "description": "タスクや要素間の依存関係をノードとエッジで可視化。クリティカルパスや循環依存を自動検出。",
      "complexity": 0.7,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "nodes",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ノードリスト。各ノードは {id: string, label: string, x?: number, y?: number} の形式。",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "edges",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "接続エッジリスト。各エッジは {sourceId: string, targetId: string, type: string} の形式。"
        },
        {
          "id": "criticalPath",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "クリティカルパス（最長依存チェーン）のノードID配列"
        },
        {
          "id": "hasLoop",
          "dataType": "boolean",
          "description": "循環依存が存在するかどうか"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "converge": [
    {
      "id": "priority_slider_grid",
      "name": "優先度スライダー",
      "description": "複数の項目に対してスライダーで優先度を設定。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度を設定する項目リスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "priorities",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度情報 {id: string, label: string, priority: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "ranking",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "優先度順のID配列"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

## ORS Data Structure
{
  "version": "5.0",
  "planMetadata": {
    "concernText": "チーム内の問題を解決したい。課題を出して、関係性を整理して、優先度つけて対策を立てたい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  },
  "entities": [
    {
      "id": "concern",
      "type": "concern",
      "attributes": [
        {
          "name": "text",
          "structuralType": "SVAL",
          "valueType": "string",
          "description": "ユーザーの元の悩みテキスト"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "dependencyGraph": {
    "dependencies": [],
    "metadata": {
      "version": "5.0",
      "generatedAt": 1765542466578
    }
  },
  "metadata": {
    "generatedAt": 1765542466578,
    "llmModel": "fallback",
    "sessionId": "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-145",
    "concernText": "チーム内の問題を解決したい。課題を出して、関係性を整理して、優先度つけて対策を立てたい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  }
}

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-145"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "資格取得の勉強計画を立てたい。範囲を洗い出して、依存関係を整理して、時系列で計画を立てたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 資格取得の勉強計画を立てたい。範囲を洗い出して、依存関係を整理して、時系列で計画を立てたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.nodes → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- dependency_mapping_0.edges → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.criticalPath → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.hasLoop → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_1.timeline → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_1.currentPosition → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
資格取得の勉強計画を立てたい。範囲を洗い出して、依存関係を整理して、時系列で計画を立てたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 資格の学習範囲を中心テーマから放射状に洗い出し、関連トピックを広げるため
Purpose: 学習範囲の全体像を発散的に洗い出す
Target: 資格勉強に必要なトピックや項目のリストアップ
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. dependency_mapping - 洗い出されたトピック間の依存関係や順序を整理して可視化するため
2. timeline_slider - 依存関係を考慮した上で学習計画を時系列で配置するため
Purpose: 発散した学習トピックを構造化して計画に落とし込む
Target: 依存関係と学習順序の整理
Ports:
dependency_mapping (complexity: 0.7):
  IN: nodes (object[])
  OUT: edges (object[])
  OUT: criticalPath (string[])
  OUT: hasLoop (boolean)

timeline_slider (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: events (object[])
  OUT: timeline (object[])
  OUT: currentPosition (number)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 学習項目の重要度や優先度を設定するため
Purpose: 学習計画の優先順位付けと集中すべき項目の絞り込み
Target: 重要度・緊急度に基づいた優先度設定
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-146"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure

  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),

  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",

- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "人生の大きな決断を控えてる。結婚、転職、引越し、全部同時に考えないといけない。まず全体像を整理して、それぞれの選択肢のメリデメを比較して、最終的にどう進むべきか優先順位をつけたい。複雑すぎて頭がパンクしそうだけど、一度きちんと整理したい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 人生の大きな決断を控えてる。結婚、転職、引越し、全部同時に考えないといけない。まず全体像を整理して、それぞれの選択肢のメリデメを比較して、最終的にどう進むべきか優先順位をつけたい。複雑すぎて頭がパンクしそうだけど、一度きちんと整理したい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → timeline_slider_0.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → timeline_slider_0.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → timeline_slider_0.events (diverge→organize)
- timeline_slider_0.timeline → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_0.currentPosition → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
人生の大きな決断を控えてる。結婚、転職、引越し、全部同時に考えないといけない。まず全体像を整理して、それぞれの選択肢のメリデメを比較して、最終的にどう進むべきか優先順位をつけたい。複雑すぎて頭がパンクしそうだけど、一度きちんと整理したい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 結婚・転職・引越しの全体像を放射状に展開し、関連性を俯瞰するため
Purpose: 発散して全体像と関連要素を洗い出す
Target: 全ての決断に関連する要素や背景を広げて整理前の素材を集める
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. timeline_slider - 複数決断の時系列的制約や順序を把握し、計画全体を見通すため
Purpose: 発散した要素を構造化し、時間軸に沿って計画性を持たせる
Target: 各イベントや意思決定を時系列順に配置し、依存関係や順序を明確にする
Ports:
timeline_slider (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: events (object[])
  OUT: timeline (object[])
  OUT: currentPosition (number)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 各選択肢や行動の優先度を定量的に設定し、意思決定を明確化するため
Purpose: 重要度と緊急度を踏まえて行動の優先順位を決定する
Target: 結婚、転職、引越しに関わる具体的タスク・行動の優先度付け
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

- sessionId: "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-150"

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "副業を始めたいが、何から手をつければいいか分からない。アイデアはいくつかあるが整理できていない"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 副業を始めたいが、何から手をつければいいか分からない。アイデアはいくつかあるが整理できていない", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
副業を始めたいが、何から手をつければいいか分からない。アイデアはいくつかあるが整理できていない

Target: 副業に関するアイデアの情報構造の把握
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - 発散フェーズで得た副業アイデアをカテゴリごとに整理し、情報を構造化する
Purpose: 集めたアイデアや情報を分類して、後の優先づけや決定に備える
Target: 副業アイデアのカテゴリ分類
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 整理されたアイデアに対して優先順位を設定し、実行計画を構築する第一歩とする

Target: 副業アイデアの優先度付け

priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "人生の選択肢を整理中。マインドマップで書き出した考えを2軸で評価したい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 人生の選択肢を整理中。マインドマップで書き出した考えを2軸で評価したい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- matrix_placement_0.placements → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- matrix_placement_0.quadrantCounts → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
人生の選択肢を整理中。マインドマップで書き出した考えを2軸で評価したい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - マインドマップを使って人生の選択肢や関連要素を広く発散・展開するため
Purpose: 選択肢や関連する考えをできるだけ多く引き出し可視化する
Target: 人生の選択肢に関する全ての関連要素や思いつきを洗い出す
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. matrix_placement - 発散した選択肢を2軸で評価し位置付けするため
Purpose: 発散した選択肢や要素を評価軸に基づき整理する
Target: 人生の選択肢に対する影響度と実現可能性の評価
Ports:
matrix_placement (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: items (object[])
  IN: axisLabels (object)
  OUT: placements (object[])
  OUT: quadrantCounts (object)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 整理された選択肢に優先順位を付けるため
Purpose: 評価された選択肢から行動に移す際の優先順位を設定する
Target: 優先的に検討・実行すべき選択肢の特定
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)

        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "matrix_placement",
      "name": "マトリクス配置",
      "description": "2軸のマトリクス上にアイテムを配置し、位置関係を可視化。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "配置するアイテムリスト",
          "required": false
        },
        {
          "id": "axisLabels",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "軸のラベル {xAxis: {low: string, high: string}, yAxis: {low: string, high: string}}",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "placements",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "アイテムの配置情報 {id: string, x: number, y: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "quadrantCounts",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "各象限のアイテム数"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "converge": [
    {
      "id": "priority_slider_grid",
      "name": "優先度スライダー",
      "description": "複数の項目に対してスライダーで優先度を設定。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度を設定する項目リスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "priorities",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度情報 {id: string, label: string, priority: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "ranking",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "優先度順のID配列"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

## ORS Data Structure

    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  }
}

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-154"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "最近なんかモヤモヤしてて気持ちが晴れない"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
[ ] emotion_palette: config.emotions (labels, 8 items)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 最近なんかモヤモヤしてて気持ちが晴れない", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- emotion_palette_0.selectedEmotions → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- emotion_palette_0.dominantEmotion → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
最近なんかモヤモヤしてて気持ちが晴れない

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. emotion_palette - 感情の洗い出しと強度の可視化を通じてモヤモヤの正体を掴む
Purpose: 広く感情を探索し、現在抱えている感情の種類と強度を認識する
Target: 心のモヤモヤの背景にある感情
Ports:
emotion_palette (complexity: 0.3):

  OUT: selectedEmotions (object[])
  OUT: dominantEmotion (string)
  GENERATE: config.emotions

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - 洗い出した感情を類似カテゴリに分類し感情パターンを整理する
Purpose: 感情を構造化し、気持ちの傾向を把握できるようにする
Target: 発散した感情情報を分類・整理
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 分類された感情の中から対処すべき感情を優先順位付けする
Purpose: 重要度・影響度の高い感情に絞り込み、アクションの焦点を定める
Target: 優先的に向き合うべき感情
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)
{
  "diverge": [
    {
      "id": "emotion_palette",
      "name": "感情パレット",
      "description": "感情をカラーパレットから選択し、強度を調整する。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "selectedEmotions",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "選択された感情リスト {emotion: string, intensity: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "dominantEmotion",
          "dataType": "string",
          "description": "最も強い感情"
        }
      ],
      "generationHints": {
        "labels": {
          "field": "emotions",
          "instruction": "ユーザーの悩みの状況で抱きがちな感情を8個生成してください。各感情には適切な色（暖色＝ポジティブ、寒色＝ネガティブなど）を設定してください。",
          "count": 8,
          "schema": {
            "id": "string (emotion_1, emotion_2, ...)",
            "label": "string (日本語、2-4文字、例: 不安、焦り、期待)",
            "color": "string (hex color, e.g., #FF6B6B)",
            "category": "string (positive|negative|neutral)",
            "description": "string (日本語、感情の説明、5-15文字)"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "card_sorting",
      "name": "カードソート",
      "description": "カードをカテゴリにドラッグ&ドロップで分類。",
      "complexity": 0.4,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "cards",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ソートするカードリスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "categories",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "カテゴリごとのカード配置"
        },
        {
          "id": "uncategorized",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "未分類のカード"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "converge": [
    {
      "id": "priority_slider_grid",
      "name": "優先度スライダー",
      "description": "複数の項目に対してスライダーで優先度を設定。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度を設定する項目リスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "priorities",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度情報 {id: string, label: string, priority: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "ranking",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "優先度順のID配列"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

## ORS Data Structure
{
  "version": "5.0",
  "planMetadata": {
    "concernText": "最近なんかモヤモヤしてて気持ちが晴れない",
    "bottleneckType": "emotional",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  },
  "entities": [
    {
      "id": "concern",
      "type": "concern",
      "attributes": [
        {
          "name": "text",
          "structuralType": "SVAL",
          "valueType": "string",
          "description": "ユーザーの元の悩みテキスト"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "dependencyGraph": {
    "dependencies": [],
    "metadata": {
      "version": "5.0",
      "generatedAt": 1765543454896
    }
  },
  "metadata": {
    "generatedAt": 1765543454896,
    "llmModel": "fallback",
    "sessionId": "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-158",
    "concernText": "最近なんかモヤモヤしてて気持ちが晴れない",
    "bottleneckType": "emotional",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  }
}

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-158"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

generatedData.rationale: 情報の不足というボトルネックに対して、まず広範囲な学習情報の洗い出し（mind_map）を行い、その後構造化（card_sorting）、優先順位付け（priority_slider_grid）を行い、最後に要約（structured_summary）する流れが有効と判断した。全ステージのcomplexityは各0.8以下に抑え、タイミングは早→中→後の順に配置している。
generatedData.flowDescription: まず発散フェーズでTOEIC学習に必要な情報を網羅的に洗い出し、整理フェーズでカテゴリ分け。収束フェーズでは優先度をつけて実行順序を決定し、まとめフェーズで学習計画を構造化して提示する。これにより、学習開始時の情報不足問題を解消し、効果的なアクションへと繋げる。

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "今抱えてるタスクが多すぎて頭の中がごちゃごちゃ。一回整理したい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 今抱えてるタスクが多すぎて頭の中がごちゃごちゃ。一回整理したい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
今抱えてるタスクが多すぎて頭の中がごちゃごちゃ。一回整理したい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - タスクを放射状に展開し、思考の全体像を可視化することで頭の中のごちゃごちゃを外在化する
Purpose: アイデアやタスクを広げて、全体像を洗い出す
Target: 頭の中に混在しているタスクや関連情報
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - 発散フェーズで洗い出したタスクをカテゴリに分類し、整理する
Purpose: 発散したタスクや情報を構造化してグループ化する
Target: マインドマップで広げたタスク群
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 整理したタスクの優先順位を設定して、次のステップの意思決定を支援する
Purpose: 優先順位を設定し、実行するタスクを絞り込む
Target: カテゴリ分けされたタスク
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)
{
  "diverge": [
    {
      "id": "mind_map",
      "name": "マインドマップ",
      "description": "中心トピックから放射状にアイデアを展開。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "centralTopic",
          "dataType": "string",
          "description": "中心トピック",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "nodes",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "マインドマップのノード"
        },
        {
          "id": "connections",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ノード間の接続"
        },
        {
          "id": "depth",
          "dataType": "number",
          "description": "最大の深さ"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "card_sorting",
      "name": "カードソート",
      "description": "カードをカテゴリにドラッグ&ドロップで分類。",
      "complexity": 0.4,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "cards",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ソートするカードリスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "categories",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "カテゴリごとのカード配置"
        },
        {
          "id": "uncategorized",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "未分類のカード"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "converge": [
    {
      "id": "priority_slider_grid",
      "name": "優先度スライダー",
      "description": "複数の項目に対してスライダーで優先度を設定。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度を設定する項目リスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "priorities",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度情報 {id: string, label: string, priority: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "ranking",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "優先度順のID配列"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

## ORS Data Structure
{
  "version": "5.0",
  "planMetadata": {
    "concernText": "今抱えてるタスクが多すぎて頭の中がごちゃごちゃ。一回整理したい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  },
  "entities": [
    {
      "id": "concern",
      "type": "concern",
      "attributes": [
        {
          "name": "text",
          "structuralType": "SVAL",
          "valueType": "string",
          "description": "ユーザーの元の悩みテキスト"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "dependencyGraph": {
    "dependencies": [],
    "metadata": {
      "version": "5.0",
      "generatedAt": 1765543749077
    }
  },
  "metadata": {
    "generatedAt": 1765543749077,
    "llmModel": "fallback",
    "sessionId": "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-161",
    "concernText": "今抱えてるタスクが多すぎて頭の中がごちゃごちゃ。一回整理したい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  }
}

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-161"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "節約したいんだけど何を削ればいいかわからない。固定費見直すべきか、日々の出費減らすべきか"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 節約したいんだけど何を削ればいいかわからない。固定費見直すべきか、日々の出費減らすべきか", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- question_card_chain_0.answers → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- question_card_chain_0.completedCount → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
節約したいんだけど何を削ればいいかわからない。固定費見直すべきか、日々の出費減らすべきか

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. question_card_chain - 固定費と日々の出費について、深掘り質問を通して思考を広げるため
Purpose: 支出に関する考えや観点を漏れなく洗い出す
Target: 出費項目に対する思い込みや盲点を明らかにする
Ports:
question_card_chain (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: questions (string[])
  OUT: answers (object[])
  OUT: completedCount (number)

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - 発散した支出項目を固定費・変動費などのカテゴリーに分類する
Purpose: 支出項目を構造化し、把握しやすくする
Target: 支出の種類や性質による分類
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 分類した支出項目に優先度をつけ、削減対象を決定する
Purpose: 削減の優先順位を明確にする
Target: 削減の対象とすべき支出項目
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)
{
  "diverge": [
    {
      "id": "question_card_chain",
      "name": "質問カードチェーン",
      "description": "質問に対する回答を連鎖的に記録し、思考の流れを可視化。",
      "complexity": 0.3,

        {

        {
          "id": "answers",

        },
        {
          "id": "completedCount",
          "dataType": "number",

        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "card_sorting",
      "name": "カードソート",
      "description": "カードをカテゴリにドラッグ&ドロップで分類。",
      "complexity": 0.4,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "cards",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ソートするカードリスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "categories",

          "description": "カテゴリごとのカード配置"
        },
        {
          "id": "uncategorized",

        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "converge": [
    {
      "id": "priority_slider_grid",

      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",

      "outputs": [

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-165"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "転職先の候補をリストアップして整理したい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 転職先の候補をリストアップして整理したい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
転職先の候補をリストアップして整理したい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 転職先候補の関連性や特徴を発散的に可視化し、漏れなくリストアップするため
Purpose: 転職先候補に関する情報や着想を広げる
Target: 転職先候補の幅広い案出し
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - 発散した候補をカテゴリ別に分け、整理された状態にするため
Purpose: 候補を分類・構造化して比較しやすくする
Target: 候補の分類と関連付け
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 整理された候補に優先順位をつけ、絞り込みを行うため
Purpose: 重要度や希望度に基づく候補の絞り込み
Target: 候補のランク付けと優先化
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])

      "complexity": 0.4,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "cards",

          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "categories",

        },

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-166"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "引越し先探してるんだけど、条件がバラバラで整理できてない。駅近がいいけど家賃も抑えたいし"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 引越し先探してるんだけど、条件がバラバラで整理できてない。駅近がいいけど家賃も抑えたいし", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- matrix_placement_0.placements → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- matrix_placement_0.quadrantCounts → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
引越し先探してるんだけど、条件がバラバラで整理できてない。駅近がいいけど家賃も抑えたいし

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 引越し条件や希望を中心トピックから放射状に広げて整理することで、思考の発散を促す。
Purpose: 条件や希望を幅広く洗い出し、関連付けを可視化する。
Target: 駅近や家賃条件などの希望や制約の全体像を出す
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. matrix_placement - 重要度とコストの2軸で条件を配置し、優先度やバランスを視覚化する。
Purpose: 発散した条件を分類・構造化して比較しやすくする。
Target: 条件間の優先度やコスト面での関係性を整理する
Ports:
matrix_placement (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: items (object[])
  IN: axisLabels (object)
  OUT: placements (object[])
  OUT: quadrantCounts (object)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 各条件に優先度スコアを付け、意思決定を支援する。
Purpose: 優先順位を明確化して意思決定を具体化する。
Target: 引越し条件の優先度を定量化する
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)
{
  "diverge": [
    {
      "id": "mind_map",
      "name": "マインドマップ",
      "description": "中心トピックから放射状にアイデアを展開。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "centralTopic",
          "dataType": "string",
          "description": "中心トピック",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "nodes",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "マインドマップのノード"
        },
        {
          "id": "connections",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ノード間の接続"
        },
        {
          "id": "depth",
          "dataType": "number",
          "description": "最大の深さ"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "matrix_placement",
      "name": "マトリクス配置",
      "description": "2軸のマトリクス上にアイテムを配置し、位置関係を可視化。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "配置するアイテムリスト",
          "required": false
        },
        {
          "id": "axisLabels",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "軸のラベル {xAxis: {low: string, high: string}, yAxis: {low: string, high: string}}",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "placements",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "アイテムの配置情報 {id: string, x: number, y: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "quadrantCounts",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "各象限のアイテム数"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "converge": [
    {
      "id": "priority_slider_grid",
      "name": "優先度スライダー",
      "description": "複数の項目に対してスライダーで優先度を設定。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度を設定する項目リスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "priorities",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度情報 {id: string, label: string, priority: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "ranking",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "優先度順のID配列"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

## ORS Data Structure
{
  "version": "5.0",
  "planMetadata": {
    "concernText": "引越し先探してるんだけど、条件がバラバラで整理できてない。駅近がいいけど家賃も抑えたいし",

    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  },
  "entities": [
    {
      "id": "concern",
      "type": "concern",
      "attributes": [
        {
          "name": "text",
          "structuralType": "SVAL",
          "valueType": "string",
          "description": "ユーザーの元の悩みテキスト"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "dependencyGraph": {
    "dependencies": [],
    "metadata": {
      "version": "5.0",
      "generatedAt": 1765544519882
    }
  },
  "metadata": {
    "generatedAt": 1765544519882,
    "llmModel": "fallback",
    "sessionId": "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-170",
    "concernText": "引越し先探してるんだけど、条件がバラバラで整理できてない。駅近がいいけど家賃も抑えたいし",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  }
}

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-170"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

generatedData.rationale: ボトルネックがthoughtのため、思考展開と整理に強いWidgetを優先的に選定。発散フェーズでは関連性を把握しやすく汎用性が高いマインドマップを使用し、整理フェーズでは比較と優先付けにつながるマトリクス配置を採用。収束フェーズには優先度付けに特化した優先度スライダーを選び、総まとめとして構造化サマリーで理解と次ステップに結びつける構成にした。それぞれcomplexityは0.5以下で、ステージ全体の流れがスムーズになるようtimingを考慮した。
generatedData.flowDescription: まずマインドマップでスキル候補を広げ、続いてマトリクス配置で重要度と必要性を基準に整理。その後、優先度スライダーで順位を付け、構造化サマリーで最終リストと理由をまとめることで、ユーザーは最も効果的な学習対象を明確にできる。

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "スキルアップしたいんだけど、何を勉強すればいいかわからない。プログラミングもいいし、英語も必要だし、マネジメントスキルも欲しい。でも時間は限られてるから全部はできない。まず候補を出して、自分のキャリアに本当に必要なものを絞りたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to スキルアップしたいんだけど、何を勉強すればいいかわからない。プログラミングもいいし、英語も必要だし、マネジメントスキルも欲しい。でも時間は限られてるから全部はできない。まず候補を出して、自分のキャリアに本当に必要なものを絞りたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- matrix_placement_0.placements → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- matrix_placement_0.quadrantCounts → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
スキルアップしたいんだけど、何を勉強すればいいかわからない。プログラミングもいいし、英語も必要だし、マネジメントスキルも欲しい。でも時間は限られてるから全部はできない。まず候補を出して、自分のキャリアに本当に必要なものを絞りたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 学びたいスキルの候補や関連分野を中心トピックから放射状に展開し、全体像を可視化することで思考の発散を促す
Purpose: 学習候補のアイデアや関連分野を幅広く洗い出す
Target: スキルアップに向けた学習テーマの候補
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. matrix_placement - 発散したスキル候補を重要度と必要性の2軸で整理し、優先度につながる視覚的構造を作る
Purpose: 広げたスキル候補を評価基準に沿って配置・分類する
Target: スキル候補の重要度と必要性による分類
Ports:
matrix_placement (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: items (object[])
  IN: axisLabels (object)
  OUT: placements (object[])
  OUT: quadrantCounts (object)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 整理済みのスキル候補に優先度スコアを設定し、学習順序を決定する
Purpose: 重要なスキル候補から優先的に取り組む順序を決める
Target: スキル候補の優先度決定
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-173"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "最近イライラしがち。何が原因か整理して落ち着きたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 最近イライラしがち。何が原因か整理して落ち着きたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- question_card_chain_0.answers → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- question_card_chain_0.completedCount → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
最近イライラしがち。何が原因か整理して落ち着きたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. question_card_chain - 質問を通じて思考を深掘りし、イライラの原因となる要素を幅広く洗い出すため
Purpose: イライラの背景にある考えや出来事を広く探索する
Target: 潜在的な原因や思考パターン
Ports:
question_card_chain (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: questions (string[])
  OUT: answers (object[])
  OUT: completedCount (number)

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - 発散した原因候補をカテゴリ別に整理し、思考の構造を明確化するため
Purpose: 原因候補や関連情報の分類
Target: 種類別・テーマ別の原因カテゴリ
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 整理された原因の中から対応すべき重要度の高いものを絞り込むため
Purpose: 優先順位づけと焦点化
Target: 最も重要で影響度の高い原因
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)
{
  "diverge": [
    {
      "id": "question_card_chain",
      "name": "質問カードチェーン",
      "description": "質問に対する回答を連鎖的に記録し、思考の流れを可視化。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "questions",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "提示する質問リスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "answers",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "回答リスト {questionId: string, answer: string}"
        },
        {
          "id": "completedCount",
          "dataType": "number",
          "description": "回答済みの質問数"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "card_sorting",
      "name": "カードソート",
      "description": "カードをカテゴリにドラッグ&ドロップで分類。",
      "complexity": 0.4,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "cards",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ソートするカードリスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "categories",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "カテゴリごとのカード配置"
        },
        {
          "id": "uncategorized",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "未分類のカード"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "converge": [
    {
      "id": "priority_slider_grid",
      "name": "優先度スライダー",
      "description": "複数の項目に対してスライダーで優先度を設定。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度を設定する項目リスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "priorities",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度情報 {id: string, label: string, priority: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "ranking",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "優先度順のID配列"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

## ORS Data Structure
{
  "version": "5.0",
  "planMetadata": {
    "concernText": "最近イライラしがち。何が原因か整理して落ち着きたい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  },
  "entities": [
    {
      "id": "concern",
      "type": "concern",
      "attributes": [
        {
          "name": "text",
          "structuralType": "SVAL",
          "valueType": "string",
          "description": "ユーザーの元の悩みテキスト"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "dependencyGraph": {
    "dependencies": [],
    "metadata": {
      "version": "5.0",
      "generatedAt": 1765545062350
    }
  },
  "metadata": {
    "generatedAt": 1765545062350,
    "llmModel": "fallback",
    "sessionId": "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-176",
    "concernText": "最近イライラしがち。何が原因か整理して落ち着きたい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  }
}

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-176"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "読みたい本がたまりすぎた。どれから読むか優先度決めて、計画的に消化したい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 読みたい本がたまりすぎた。どれから読むか優先度決めて、計画的に消化したい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.nodes → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.items (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (diverge→organize)
- matrix_placement_0.placements → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- matrix_placement_0.quadrantCounts → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
読みたい本がたまりすぎた。どれから読むか優先度決めて、計画的に消化したい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 読書予定の本を中心トピックに据えて内容や興味の関連性を広げ、全体像を把握するため
Purpose: 読書対象に関する情報や連想を発散的に整理する
Target: 本に関するジャンル、テーマ、関心度の広がりを可視化する
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. matrix_placement - 本を重要度と緊急度の2軸で分類し、優先読みの候補を絞り込むため
Purpose: 発散された本リストを構造化し、優先度判断に必要な位置づけを行う
Target: 各本の重要度・緊急度に基づいた俯瞰整理
Ports:
matrix_placement (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: items (object[])
  IN: axisLabels (object)
  OUT: placements (object[])
  OUT: quadrantCounts (object)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - マトリクス整理後の本を具体的な読書優先順位に落とし込むため
Purpose: 読書対象を実際に読み進める順序へ収束させる
Target: 本ごとの優先度設定と優先順位リスト作成
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)
{
  "diverge": [
    {
      "id": "mind_map",
      "name": "マインドマップ",
      "description": "中心トピックから放射状にアイデアを展開。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "centralTopic",
          "dataType": "string",
          "description": "中心トピック",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "nodes",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "マインドマップのノード"
        },
        {
          "id": "connections",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "ノード間の接続"
        },
        {
          "id": "depth",
          "dataType": "number",
          "description": "最大の深さ"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "matrix_placement",
      "name": "マトリクス配置",
      "description": "2軸のマトリクス上にアイテムを配置し、位置関係を可視化。",
      "complexity": 0.5,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "配置するアイテムリスト",
          "required": false
        },
        {
          "id": "axisLabels",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "軸のラベル {xAxis: {low: string, high: string}, yAxis: {low: string, high: string}}",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "placements",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "アイテムの配置情報 {id: string, x: number, y: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "quadrantCounts",
          "dataType": "object",
          "description": "各象限のアイテム数"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "converge": [
    {
      "id": "priority_slider_grid",
      "name": "優先度スライダー",
      "description": "複数の項目に対してスライダーで優先度を設定。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "items",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度を設定する項目リスト",
          "required": false
        }
      ],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "priorities",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "優先度情報 {id: string, label: string, priority: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "ranking",
          "dataType": "string[]",
          "description": "優先度順のID配列"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

## ORS Data Structure
{
  "version": "5.0",
  "planMetadata": {
    "concernText": "読みたい本がたまりすぎた。どれから読むか優先度決めて、計画的に消化したい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  },
  "entities": [
    {
      "id": "concern",
      "type": "concern",
      "attributes": [
        {
          "name": "text",
          "structuralType": "SVAL",
          "valueType": "string",
          "description": "ユーザーの元の悩みテキスト"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "dependencyGraph": {
    "dependencies": [],
    "metadata": {
      "version": "5.0",
      "generatedAt": 1765545523189
    }
  },
  "metadata": {
    "generatedAt": 1765545523189,
    "llmModel": "fallback",
    "sessionId": "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-181",
    "concernText": "読みたい本がたまりすぎた。どれから読むか優先度決めて、計画的に消化したい",
    "bottleneckType": "thought",
    "sections": [
      "diverge",
      "organize",
      "converge"
    ]
  }
}

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-181"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)
