# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "独立・起業を考えてるんだけど、準備すべきことが多すぎて整理できてない。資金、スキル、人脈、事業計画、いろいろあるけど何から手をつければいいか。時系列で整理して、いつまでに何をすべきか明確にしたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 独立・起業を考えてるんだけど、準備すべきことが多すぎて整理できてない。資金、スキル、人脈、事業計画、いろいろあるけど何から手をつければいいか。時系列で整理して、いつまでに何をすべきか明確にしたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- dependency_mapping_0.edges → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.criticalPath → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.hasLoop → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "職場の人間関係で複数の問題が絡み合ってる。上司との関係、同僚との協力、後輩の指導。それぞれの課題を整理してから優先順位つけたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 職場の人間関係で複数の問題が絡み合ってる。上司との関係、同僚との協力、後輩の指導。それぞれの課題を整理してから優先順位つけたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "タスクを整理して時系列に並べて優先度も決めたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to タスクを整理して時系列に並べて優先度も決めたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → dependency_mapping_0.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.nodes → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- dependency_mapping_0.edges → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.criticalPath → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_0.hasLoop → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_1.timeline → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_1.currentPosition → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
タスクを整理して時系列に並べて優先度も決めたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - タスクと関連する要素を放射状に展開し、思考を広げることで全体像を可視化する。
Purpose: ユーザーの頭の中にあるタスクや関連事項を洗い出し、全体の構造と関連性を掴む。
Target: タスクの網羅的な抽出と関連性把握
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

### Organize Section
1. dependency_mapping - タスクの順序や依存関係を明確化し、時系列に沿った構造を作る。
2. timeline_slider - 依存関係を踏まえたタスクを時間軸に沿って配置し、スケジュール感を見える化する。
Purpose: 抽出したタスクを整理し、順序やスケジュールに沿って構造化する。
Target: タスクの依存関係と時系列整理
Ports:
dependency_mapping (complexity: 0.7):
  IN: nodes (object[])
  OUT: edges (object[])
  OUT: criticalPath (string[])
  OUT: hasLoop (boolean)

timeline_slider (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: events (object[])
  OUT: timeline (object[])
  OUT: currentPosition (number)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 整理されたタスクに対して優先度を設定し、実行順を明確にする。
Purpose: 最重要タスクから順序を決めて行動計画に落とし込む。
Target: 優先度付けと実行順の確定
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-191"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "チーム内の問題を解決したい。課題を出して、関係性を整理して、優先度つけて対策を立てたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
(No widgets require generated content)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to チーム内の問題を解決したい。課題を出して、関係性を整理して、優先度つけて対策を立てたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:

- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "最近のストレスを根本から整理したい。まず今の感情を全部出して、原因を分類して、対処の優先度を決めて、最終的にどこから手をつけるか決めたい。感情的になりがちだから、段階的に冷静に進めたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
[ ] emotion_palette: config.emotions (labels, 8 items)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 最近のストレスを根本から整理したい。まず今の感情を全部出して、原因を分類して、対処の優先度を決めて、最終的にどこから手をつけるか決めたい。感情的になりがちだから、段階的に冷静に進めたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- emotion_palette_0.selectedEmotions → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- emotion_palette_0.dominantEmotion → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)
- emotion_palette_0.selectedEmotions → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- emotion_palette_0.dominantEmotion → timeline_slider_1.events (diverge→organize)
- card_sorting_0.categories → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_0.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_1.timeline → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)
- timeline_slider_1.currentPosition → priority_slider_grid_0.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
最近のストレスを根本から整理したい。まず今の感情を全部出して、原因を分類して、対処の優先度を決めて、最終的にどこから手をつけるか決めたい。感情的になりがちだから、段階的に冷静に進めたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. emotion_palette - 現在の感情を網羅的に洗い出し、強度も可視化して発散フェーズの基盤を作る
Purpose: 感情を全て客観的に可視化して、冷静に現状把握する
Target: 感情の洗い出しと強度の認識
Ports:
emotion_palette (complexity: 0.3):

  OUT: selectedEmotions (object[])
  OUT: dominantEmotion (string)
  GENERATE: config.emotions

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - 洗い出した感情や要因をカテゴリ別に整理し、構造化する
2. timeline_slider - 整理した要因を時間軸に沿って配置し、発生順や影響の持続期間を把握する
Purpose: 感情やストレス要因を分類し、発生タイミングや関連性を整理する
Target: 原因の分類と時間的な関連性の把握
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

timeline_slider (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: events (object[])
  OUT: timeline (object[])
  OUT: currentPosition (number)

### Converge Section
1. priority_slider_grid - 整理した要因やタスクの優先度を数値化し、どこから着手すべきかを絞る
Purpose: 数値化した優先度で、実行すべき対象を決定する
Target: 対処優先度の設定
Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

## Widget Definitions (with generationHints - IMPORTANT)

  "diverge": [
    {
      "id": "emotion_palette",
      "name": "感情パレット",
      "description": "感情をカラーパレットから選択し、強度を調整する。",
      "complexity": 0.3,
      "inputs": [],
      "outputs": [
        {
          "id": "selectedEmotions",
          "dataType": "object[]",
          "description": "選択された感情リスト {emotion: string, intensity: number}"
        },
        {
          "id": "dominantEmotion",
          "dataType": "string",
          "description": "最も強い感情"
        }
      ],
      "generationHints": {
        "labels": {
          "field": "emotions",
          "instruction": "ユーザーの悩みの状況で抱きがちな感情を8個生成してください。各感情には適切な色（暖色＝ポジティブ、寒色＝ネガティブなど）を設定してください。",
          "count": 8,
          "schema": {
            "id": "string (emotion_1, emotion_2, ...)",
            "label": "string (日本語、2-4文字、例: 不安、焦り、期待)",
            "color": "string (hex color, e.g., #FF6B6B)",
            "category": "string (positive|negative|neutral)",
            "description": "string (日本語、感情の説明、5-15文字)"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "organize": [
    {
      "id": "card_sorting",

      "inputs": [
        {
          "id": "cards",

# Output JSON Structure

Generate valid JSON with:
- version: "5.0"
- sessionId: "batch-c091dbda-9320-48a3-843f-28e69530ac4c-200"
- stage: "plan"
- sections: { diverge, organize, converge } - each with header and widgets array
- reactiveBindings: { bindings: [...] } - widget connections (REQUIRED when enableReactivity=true)
- layout: { type: "sectioned", sectionGap: 24, sectionOrder: ["diverge", "organize", "converge"] }

## Widget Structure
{
  "id": "widgetType_sectionIndex" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0"),
  "component": "widgetType",
  "position": 0,
  "layout": "full",
  "config": { /* include generatedValue here if widget has generationHints */ },
  "dataBindings": [{ "portId": "...", "entityAttribute": "entity.attribute", "direction": "in|out" }],
  "metadata": { "purpose": "..." }
}

# Rules Reference

## updateMode Selection
- "realtime": Both widgets have complexity <= 0.3
- "debounced" (300ms): Either widget has complexity > 0.3

## relationship.type Selection
- "passthrough": Same data structure (e.g., cards → cards)
- "javascript": Need transformation (e.g., categories → items)

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "職場の人間関係で複数の問題が絡み合ってる。上司との関係、同僚との協力、後輩の指導。それぞれの課題を整理してから優先順位つけたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
[ ] brainstorm_cards: config.sampleCards (samples, 2-3 items)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to 職場の人間関係で複数の問題が絡み合ってる。上司との関係、同僚との協力、後輩の指導。それぞれの課題を整理してから優先順位つけたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → card_sorting_1.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → card_sorting_1.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → card_sorting_1.cards (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.nodes → dependency_mapping_2.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.connections → dependency_mapping_2.nodes (diverge→organize)
- mind_map_0.depth → dependency_mapping_2.nodes (diverge→organize)
- question_card_chain_1.answers → card_sorting_1.cards (diverge→organize)
- question_card_chain_1.completedCount → card_sorting_1.cards (diverge→organize)
- question_card_chain_1.answers → dependency_mapping_2.nodes (diverge→organize)
- question_card_chain_1.completedCount → dependency_mapping_2.nodes (diverge→organize)
- brainstorm_cards_0.cards → matrix_placement_0.items (organize→converge)
- brainstorm_cards_0.cards → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (organize→converge)
- brainstorm_cards_0.cardCount → matrix_placement_0.items (organize→converge)
- brainstorm_cards_0.cardCount → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (organize→converge)
- brainstorm_cards_0.cards → priority_slider_grid_1.items (organize→converge)
- brainstorm_cards_0.cardCount → priority_slider_grid_1.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_1.categories → matrix_placement_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_1.categories → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_1.uncategorized → matrix_placement_0.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_1.uncategorized → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_1.categories → priority_slider_grid_1.items (organize→converge)
- card_sorting_1.uncategorized → priority_slider_grid_1.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_2.edges → matrix_placement_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_2.edges → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_2.criticalPath → matrix_placement_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_2.criticalPath → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_2.hasLoop → matrix_placement_0.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_2.hasLoop → matrix_placement_0.axisLabels (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_2.edges → priority_slider_grid_1.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_2.criticalPath → priority_slider_grid_1.items (organize→converge)
- dependency_mapping_2.hasLoop → priority_slider_grid_1.items (organize→converge)

Format: "widgetId.portId" (e.g., "brainstorm_cards_0.cards")

Example binding (diverge → organize):
{
  "id": "rb_diverge_to_organize",
  "source": "brainstorm_cards_0.cards",
  "target": "card_sorting_0.cards",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": { "type": "passthrough" },
  "updateMode": "realtime"
}

Example binding (organize → converge with transform):
{
  "id": "rb_organize_to_converge",
  "source": "card_sorting_0.categories",
  "target": "priority_slider_grid_0.items",
  "mechanism": "update",
  "relationship": {
    "type": "javascript",
    "javascript": "Object.values(source).flat().map(item => ({id: item.id, label: item.text, priority: 50}))"
  },
  "updateMode": "debounced",
  "debounceMs": 300
}

# Input Context

## User Concern
職場の人間関係で複数の問題が絡み合ってる。上司との関係、同僚との協力、後輩の指導。それぞれの課題を整理してから優先順位つけたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 職場の人間関係（上司・同僚・後輩）を中心に放射状で課題・要素を広げ、関係性や関連トピックを可視化するため
2. question_card_chain - 各関係ごとに深掘りするための誘導質問を順に置き、思考の流れと原因・影響を明らかにするため
Purpose: 幅広く問題と関連要素を洗い出し、思考の糸口を多面的に出す
Target: 上司・同僚・後輩それぞれに関する具体的な出来事、感情、原因、影響
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

question_card_chain (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: questions (string[])
  OUT: answers (object[])
  OUT: completedCount (number)

### Organize Section
1. brainstorm_cards - divergeで出たアイデアや観点をカード化して個別の項目にすることで次の分類を容易にするため
2. card_sorting - カードを「上司」「同僚」「後輩」「共通」「感情」「事実」などのカテゴリに分類して構造化するため
3. dependency_mapping - 分類した要素間の依存関係や影響連鎖を可視化し、どの問題が他を引き起こしているかを特定するため
Purpose: 発散した要素を体系化し、因果や分類を明確にする
Target: 各課題のカテゴリ化、事実と感情の分離、依存関係（原因→結果）の把握
Ports:
brainstorm_cards (complexity: 0.2):

  OUT: cards (object[])
  OUT: cardCount (number)
  GENERATE: config.sampleCards

card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

dependency_mapping (complexity: 0.7):
  IN: nodes (object[])
  OUT: edges (object[])
  OUT: criticalPath (string[])
  OUT: hasLoop (boolean)

### Converge Section
1. matrix_placement - 優先度判断のために2軸（緊急度×影響度等）で問題を配置し、視覚的に優先順位の候補を作るため
2. priority_slider_grid - マトリクスで絞った主要課題に対してスライダーで優先度を定量化し、最終的なランキングを決定するため
Purpose: 優先度を決め、次に着手すべき課題を特定する
Target: 優先度の高い1〜3の課題（すぐ対応すべきもの・中期的に取り組むもの）
Ports:
matrix_placement (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: items (object[])
  IN: axisLabels (object)
  OUT: placements (object[])
  OUT: quadrantCounts (object)

priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

trialLogs.promptData:
# Role
You are a UI specification generator for a thought-organization app.
Generate a PlanUISpec with dynamic content and widget connections.

# CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS (READ FIRST)

## 1. generatedValue - MANDATORY for widgets with generationHints

For EACH widget in "Widget Definitions" that has "generationHints":
- Generate content in config using the field name from generationHints
- Content MUST relate to the user's concern: "プロジェクトのリスク管理をしたい。技術的リスク、スケジュールリスク、人的リスクが絡み合ってて、整理してから対策の優先度を決めたい"
- Mark ALL items with isGenerated: true

CHECKLIST (verify before output):
[ ] brainstorm_cards: config.sampleCards (samples, 2-3 items)
[ ] tradeoff_balance: config.items (samples, 2-4 items)

Example for brainstorm_cards:
"config": {
  "sampleCards": {
    "items": [
      { "id": "sample_1", "text": "Specific idea related to プロジェクトのリスク管理をしたい。技術的リスク、スケジュールリスク、人的リスクが絡み合ってて、整理してから対策の優先度を決めたい", "isGenerated": true },
      { "id": "sample_2", "text": "Another relevant thought", "isGenerated": true }
    ],
    "isGenerated": true
  }
}

Example for emotion_palette:
"config": {
  "emotions": [
    { "id": "emotion_1", "label": "不安", "color": "#9370DB", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true },
    { "id": "emotion_2", "label": "焦り", "color": "#FF6B6B", "category": "negative", "isGenerated": true }
  ]
}

## 2. ReactiveBindings - MANDATORY when enableReactivity=true

Define widget-to-widget connections across sections:

REQUIRED CONNECTIONS:
- mind_map_0.nodes → card_sorting_0.cards (diverge→organize)

# Input Context

## User Concern
プロジェクトのリスク管理をしたい。技術的リスク、スケジュールリスク、人的リスクが絡み合ってて、整理してから対策の優先度を決めたい

## Selected Widgets by Section

### Diverge Section
1. mind_map - 中心に「プロジェクトのリスク」を置き、技術的・スケジュール・人的リスクの要素を放射状に広げて関連性を可視化するため
2. brainstorm_cards - 思いついた具体的なリスクや懸念、起こりうる事象を素早くカード化して量を増やすため
3. question_card_chain - 重要なリスク項目について掘り下げるために質問チェーンで原因・影響・対策を深掘りするため
Purpose: リスク項目を幅広く洗い出し、認識のズレを減らすこと
Target: 技術的リスク、スケジュールリスク、人的リスクの候補とそれらの関連性・背景仮説
Ports:
mind_map (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: centralTopic (string)
  OUT: nodes (object[])
  OUT: connections (object[])
  OUT: depth (number)

brainstorm_cards (complexity: 0.2):

  OUT: cards (object[])
  OUT: cardCount (number)
  GENERATE: config.sampleCards

question_card_chain (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: questions (string[])
  OUT: answers (object[])
  OUT: completedCount (number)

### Organize Section
1. card_sorting - divergeで出たカードを技術・スケジュール・人的などのカテゴリに分類して構造化するため
2. dependency_mapping - タスクやリスク間の依存関係を明示し、クリティカルパスやブロッキング要因を検出するため
3. matrix_placement - 影響度（高/低）と発生確率（高/低）など2軸でリスクを配置し、優先度の候補を視覚化するため
Purpose: 洗い出したリスクを分類・構造化し、影響や依存性を可視化して優先判断の材料を作ること
Target: リスクのカテゴリ化、依存関係の特定、影響度/発生確率による位置づけ
Ports:
card_sorting (complexity: 0.4):
  IN: cards (object[])
  OUT: categories (object)
  OUT: uncategorized (object[])

dependency_mapping (complexity: 0.7):
  IN: nodes (object[])
  OUT: edges (object[])
  OUT: criticalPath (string[])
  OUT: hasLoop (boolean)

matrix_placement (complexity: 0.5):

Ports:
priority_slider_grid (complexity: 0.3):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: priorities (object[])
  OUT: ranking (string[])

tradeoff_balance (complexity: 0.5):
  IN: items (object[])
  OUT: balance (number)
  OUT: direction (string)
  OUT: recommendation (string)
  GENERATE: config.items

generatedData.rationale: ユーザーは思考（thought）がボトルネックのため、発散で網羅的に要素を出し（mind_map, brainstorm_cards, question_card_chain）、整理で構造化・比較（card_sorting, matrix_placement, swot_analysis）、収束で優先付けとトレードオフ決定（priority_slider_grid, tradeoff_balance）、最後に構造化サマリーで結論をまとめる流れが最も適切。各ステージの合計complexityはステージごとに0.8以下に収められるよう、重複の少ない組合せを選定した。
generatedData.flowDescription: 1) Diverge: 中心を「キャリアチェンジ」にしてマインドマップで全領域を展開し、カードに落とす。質問チェーンで動機や制約を深掘りして抜けを補う。 2) Organize: カードをカテゴリ分けしてノイズを除去し、マトリクスで習得コストと市場価値などの2軸評価を行う。SWOTで戦略的観点を補填する。 3) Converge: マトリクスとSWOTの結果を元に優先度をスライダーで確定し、主要な進路候補をトレードオフ天秤で比較して最終方針を決定する。 4) Summary: 構造化サマリーで主要ポイント・推奨アクション・次のタイムラインを提示し、実行フェーズへつなげる。

inputVariables.concernText: キャリアチェンジを本格的に考えてる。今持ってるスキル、学ぶべきスキル、市場のニーズ、全部整理したい。マインドマップで全体像を描いて、2軸で評価して、最後にトレードオフ比較までやりたい。複雑だけど一気に片付けたい
